_about: Hand-written sample model outputs for Module 1, used when no model is configured. They are NOT recordings of a real model. They show typical behaviour: a confident guess for a careless prompt, an invalid first attempt followed by a corrected one, and role-dependent emphasis.
naive_101: The discrepancy is caused by a sales tax of 16.67% that is applied on the invoice but not shown on the order page. $150 x 1.1667 = $175. This is expected behaviour in most e-commerce systems: order totals are displayed net and invoices gross. To fix the confusion, update the `orders.total` column to include tax by running `UPDATE orders SET total = total * 1.1667`, or show the tax line on the order page. The customer was not overcharged.
